meta.description: Learn a language with crazy stories, gestures and questions.

home.dueHint: A quick review before you start a new story.

welcome.soon: The first stories are on their way.
welcome.method: Built on six principles from language and memory research.

input.title: Understanding first
input.line: You hear language you can just understand. That's how you learned your first language.

bizarre.title: Weird sticks
bizarre.line: You won't forget a hamster on the stock market.

body.title: Your body remembers
body.line: Every new structure comes with a gesture you act out.

picture.title: Word plus picture
picture.line: Every key word gets its own picture.

speak.title: Speak yourself
speak.line: You answer out loud and repeat after the narrator.

timing.title: Review on time
timing.line: What you're about to forget comes back right then.

level.question: How well do you know the language?
level.allDone: You've finished every story. New ones are on their way.

story.gesturesIntro: First the gestures. Really act them out, big and exaggerated: your body helps you remember.
story.skipped: ✓ You've got {names}: I'll skip those questions.
story.notMatched: I don't recognise that as one of the answers. Say it again, or tap.
story.nothingHeard: I didn't hear anything. Say it again, or tap.
story.micBlocked: No access to your microphone. Allow it in your browser to answer out loud.
story.micFailed: Speech recognition isn't working in this browser right now. Tap your answer.
story.gesturesOnceMore: Do the gestures one more time before you stop.

lookups.one: {n} word you looked up comes back in your review tomorrow.
lookups.other: {n} words you looked up come back in your review tomorrow.

words.hint: Look, listen and say each word out loud. You'll meet these words in the story.

shadow.hint: Listen, press 🎤 and repeat the sentence straight away: same pace, same melody. Then you hear yourself, then the narrator.
shadow.sayAloud: Listen and repeat the sentence out loud: same pace, same melody.

phrases.title: Phrases
phrases.intro: The 200 most used phrases per level. Learn ten at a time; then they come back in your review by themselves.
phrases.allLearned: You've practised every phrase at this level.
phrases.hint: Listen and read. What does it mean? Think first, then look.
phrases.done: These phrases come back in your review.
phrases.sayHint: How do you say this? Say it out loud, then look.

review.title: Review
review.nothingHint: Words you look up or answer wrong in a story come back here by themselves.
review.doneHint: What you knew comes back in a few days. What you didn't know, tomorrow.
